scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Alligators?
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
你打够50只鳄鱼人了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
嗯，我觉得你还没打够50只...

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Remember, I need help hunting Alligators so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
记住，我需要帮忙打鳄鱼人，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
好吧，如果你改变主意，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Please kill 50 Alligators.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
请打50只鳄鱼人。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
真厉害，你完成得这么快。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
You look like a sturdy adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
你看起来是个强壮的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
I was sent here to minimize the Alligator population but the task is proving to be quite difficult for just me to complete.
How'd you like to help me out?
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
我被派来这里是为了减少鳄鱼人的数量，但这任务对我来说太难了，我一个人无法完成。
你愿意帮我一把吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
You can help me out by either hunting Alligators or by gathering items for me.
Which would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
你可以通过打鳄鱼人或为我收集物品来帮忙。
你想做哪一个？

scripts.text: Gather Items
scripts.translation: 收集物品

scripts.text: Hunt Alligators
scripts.translation: 打鳄鱼人

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
If you can bring me ^00CC0020 Anolian Skins^000000. I'll help you get stronger.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
如果你能给我^00CC0020张虎蜥皮^000000，我会帮你变强。

scripts.text: I have the Anolian Skins
scripts.translation: 我有虎蜥皮

scripts.text: Gators bite!
scripts.translation: 鳄鱼人咬人！

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Thank you for the ^00CE0020 Anolian Skins^000000!
I hope you can continue to help me collect these skins.
The armor creators around the world are clamoring for them.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
谢谢你给我^00CE0020张虎蜥皮^000000！
希望你能继续帮我收集这些皮。
世界各地的盔甲工匠都在争抢它们。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
I know a gator skin when I see it and I don't see ^00CE0020 Anolian Skins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
我一眼就能认出鳄鱼人的皮，但我没看到^00CE0020张虎蜥皮^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
I need ^00CE0020 Anolian Skins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
我需要^00CE0020张虎蜥皮^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Alligators.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
啊，好的，我想你可以通过打一些鳄鱼人来帮我。
你想打多少只？

scripts.text: 50 Alligators
scripts.translation: 50只鳄鱼人

scripts.text: 100 Alligators
scripts.translation: 100只鳄鱼人

scripts.text: 150 Alligators
scripts.translation: 150只鳄鱼人

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
Come back when you've finished your task and I will give you a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
完成任务后再回来，我会给你一点小奖励。

scripts.translation:

如果你改变主意，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
如果你改变主意，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
You are too powerful for this task, I need the skins in fair condition, not exploded!
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
你太强了，不适合这个任务。我需要皮保持完好，而不是被炸成碎片！

scripts.text:
[Cuir]
You certainly are brave, but bravery turns to foolishness if you continue going East.
Perhaps when you are stronger you and I can do business.
scripts.translation:
[库伊尔]
你确实很勇敢，但如果继续往东走，勇敢就会变成鲁莽。
也许等你变强了，我们再合作。
